scope: regression guard for the recorded random 0-ary relation negative boundary
guard_statement: The recorded counterexample with a random 0-ary relation symbol P has Pr[A_n models P] = 1/2 for every n, so its limiting probability is 1/2 and not in {0,1}. Any future positive 0-1 law surface must either exclude random 0-ary relation symbols or make them deterministic.
checked_boundary: Pr[A_n models P] = 1/2 for every n
positive arity is necessary unless 0-ary relation symbols are excluded or deterministic
boundary: This receipt is only a regression guard for the existing random 0-ary relation negative boundary. It does not prove a global vocabulary closure, unrestricted finite-model-theory closure, Fagin theorem, or Lean-formal counterexample theorem.
